item.description: This post walks through building a Microsoft Sentinel Codeless Connector Framework (CCF) RestApiPoller connector that uses the nested API polling pattern. Instead, they use a two-step model: a list endpoint that returns identifiers, followed by a detail endpoint that accepts one identifier and returns the full record.
